function unbox<T>(source: { [K in keyof T]: { value: T[K] } }): T {
  return source as unknown as T;
}
class PrivateBoxes { x = { value: 1 }; private y = { value: 'a' }; }
class ProtectedBoxes { x = { value: 1 }; protected y = { value: 'a' }; }
class SecretBoxes { x = { value: 1 }; #y = { value: 'a' }; }
class PublicBoxes { x = { value: 1 }; readonly y = { value: 'a' }; }
const p = unbox(new PrivateBoxes());
const q = unbox(new ProtectedBoxes());
const secret = unbox(new SecretBoxes());
const visibleKey: keyof typeof secret = 'x';
const wrongKey: keyof typeof secret = '#y';
const result = unbox(new PublicBoxes());
result.y = 'b';
